specs.Item Type Name: TRONICA Republic Series 4.1 Bluetooth Subwoofer Home Theater with FM/AUX/USB/SD Card Support Along with All Function Remote Control
specs.Compatible Devices: Bluetooth, Smart TV & Smartphone, LED tv, Laptop, Computer and Mobile

features: 30W 4.1 multimedia speakers with usb/sd card/fm/aux/bluetooth support

For a Quality Audio Experience :A stylish and affordable 4.1 speaker system which delivers quality audio and extended bass for your music, movies or PC games. Get realistic audio from its four compact satellite speakers and powerful ported subwoofer. This value-packed system also lets you enjoy the convenience of a wired remote control for easy access.

Excellent Output :The Tronica 4.1 Speaker System features a whopping 2500w PMPO (Peak Music Power Output) so that extremely influential sound fills your space. For those who like to thrill with soaring volume, the Speaker Set is thus an ideal choice. Audio quality further gets enhanced by its wooden cabinet that checks unwieldy distortions. Moreover, the tower shaping of the Satellite Speakers is also a performance-oriented designing aspect.

Looks Classy, Offers Comfort : The Tronica 4.1 Speaker System has an elegant black exterior. Further, its Satellite Speakers fascinate you with the glisten of their texture. With a bass controller and an indicator for LED power, you bring home convenience along with this Speaker Set.
description: We feel proud to launch the pocket friendly fully loaded REPUBLIC SERIES from TRONICA,keeping in mind the supreme quality with all features at a price which suits each & every Indian individual.We are trying to meet the needs of customers who are not necessarily willing to spend loads of money and/or remodel the living room in the pursuit of the best home movie experience.Our multimedia speakers in Republic Series deliver a theater like audio quality from a simple,affordable, and easy operational music system. This 4.1 home theater has all the desired features of an audiophile.Connect a pen drive, insert a sd card, tune into your favourite FM channels,connect it to ur LED tv or computer or any aux source,and lastly the Bluetooth-can be paired easily with any BT device. An all function remote control eases the operation from a distance of 7-8 feet.
